description: Is a commodity really dearer now than it was in a given month, after US inflation?. Takes a World Bank Pink Sheet commodity or index and a historical month, deflates by US headline CPI and returns the old price in today's dollars, nominal and real change, nominal annualised growth and the inflation-adjusted all-time peak month. Computed by Lilambd. Routes: /items (limit); /answer (item*, month*). Paid $0.5 USDC per call via x402 (_meta["x402/payment"]); set sample=true for a free 3-row preview.

route.description: One of: /items, /answer. Replace {placeholders} with a value, e.g. /search or /HND.

name: real-commodity-price
